title: Your monthly viewing recap
summary: Open Monthly recap from Statistics to look back at a completed month, with watch time, favourite movies and series, daily activity and viewer totals.
highlights: Choose a month and see everyone's viewing or filter to one viewer. Recaps use recorded History and label estimated watch time.
Statistics has shared Overview and Monthly recap tabs, a revised viewing-period selector, readable chart labels on smaller screens and better spacing around poster scrollbars.
Notification settings warnings now name the providers with incomplete or invalid settings. The notification-device list in Settings also uses the full available width.
